name: local-remote-mcp
description: Primary Local Remote MCP for project-authorized file, search and terminal control. Global routing may use the hosted Official Remote MCP only after a confirmed same-target Local runtime/startup/transport failure.

interface.longDescription: Use Local Remote MCP as the primary machine-control path. Every local tool call is re-authorized through local .control; same-target Official fallback is allowed only after confirmed Local runtime/startup/transport failure under L1 policy.
